purpose: Compare w_fgd / w_fgd_balanced against fgd and every other registered algorithm (8 node policies + 3 H-TAFM variants) across every gputrace stress scenario, with broader (fairness/tail-latency/SLA/efficiency) metrics.

gputrace.note: commit hash of the clone this run was generated from -- verify this matches the live repo's HEAD at reproduction time if you need byte-identical scenario logic; only CI/lint config was changed relative to it, not generators/, so behavior should match any commit descended from it.

generation.fit_source: reference (no --fit passed; gputrace's built-in reference_fit(), NOT a real trace -- see gputrace README's own caveat about this)

export.node_gpu_types: mixed (A100/V100/T4/H100 weighted by scenario's gpu_type distribution -- see gputrace_bridge.py)

py_sim.git_commit_this_run_was_built_on: see git log -1 in this repo at time of running reproduce.sh

static_matrix.seeds: n/a (static mode is deterministic given a fixed pod order for every policy except 'random')

reproduce: See reproduce.sh in this directory -- runs the exact 3 commands above against the archived gputrace_raw/ + gputrace_export/ data already checked into this directory, so this reproduces even if gputrace's scenario generation logic later changes upstream. To regenerate the raw data from scratch instead (e.g. to test against a newer gputrace version), delete gputrace_raw/ and gputrace_export/ and re-run the generation+export commands above with the same seed.
